messages.message: ### Step 2: Direct Translation Translate each source line into Bengali, guided by the Reference Translation and Step 1 analysis. Output: ONE Bengali line per source line (preserve line count and end punctuation). Rules: - Follow the meaning from Reference Translation. - For "so X that Y": keep resultative structure, do NOT convert to "because". - No internal punctuation; copy only end punctuation from source.
আমি উপরে তাকালাম এবং তার কাঁধ দেখলাম যা ইতিমধ্যে গ্রহের রশ্মি দ্বারা আবৃত যা মানুষকে প্রতিটি পথে সরলভাবে পরিচালনা করে।

### Step 3: Word Table & Coverage Check Build a word table from Step 2 translation, mapping each source word to its target equivalent. Output: ONE Markdown table (all lines combined). Columns: [Source Word] | [Contextual Definition] | [Target Word/Phrase] | [Back-Translation] | [Status: OK/MISSING/WRONG/GRAMMAR/UNNECESSARY] Mark GRAMMAR for agreement errors (gender, number, case) or other grammatical mistakes. Mark UNNECESSARY for elements present in source but not needed in target language (e.g., articles that target language omits naturally). After the table, list any MISSING, WRONG, GRAMMAR, or UNNECESSARY items.

**Word‑to‑Word Alignment Table (Source → Bengali)**
| Source Word | Contextual Definition | Target Word / Phrase | Back‑Translation (Bengali → English) | Status | |-------------|----------------------|----------------------|---------------------------------------|--------| | guardai | “looked” (1st sg. perfect) | তাকালাম | “looked” | OK | | in | preposition “in” (part of “in alto”) | উপরে | “up / high” | OK | | alto | “high” (noun used adverbially) | উপরে | “up / high” | OK | | e | coordinating conjunction “and” | এবং | “and” | OK | | vidi | “saw” (1st sg. perfect) | দেখলাম | “saw” | OK | | le | definite article (fem. pl.) – not expressed in Bengali | — | — | **UNNECESSARY** (article omitted) | | sue | possessive adjective “its” | তার | “its / his / her” | OK | | spalle | “shoulders” (acc.) | কাঁধ | “shoulder(s)” | OK | | vestite | past participle “clothed / covered” | আবৃত | “clothed / covered” | OK | | già | adverb “already” | ইতিমধ্যে | “already” | OK | | de' | preposition + article “of the” (before *raggi*) | এর | “of” (genitive) | OK | | raggi | “rays” (pl.) | রশ্মি | “rays” | OK | | del | preposition + article “of the” (before *pianeta*) | এর | “of” (genitive) | OK | | pianeta | “planet” (sg.) | গ্রহ | “planet” | OK | | che | relative pronoun “that / which” | যা | “that / which” | OK | | mena | verb “leads / guides” (3rd sg. pres.) | পরিচালনা করে | “guides / leads” | OK | | dritto | adverb “straight / aright” | সরলভাবে | “straight / plainly” | OK | | altrui | “men / people” (indirect object) | মানুষকে | “people (to)” | OK | | per | preposition “for / along” | প্রতি | “for / each” (as part of “প্রতিটি”) | OK | | ogne | adjective “every” | প্রতিটি | “every” | OK | | calle | noun “path / way” (sg.) | পথে | “path / way (locative)” | OK |
### Items that need attention - **UNNECESSARY**: - **le** – Italian definite article has no counterpart in Bengali; it is naturally omitted. - **আমি** – the Bengali subject pronoun “I” appears in the translation but is not present in the source; Bengali can drop the pronoun, so it is unnecessary for strict word‑to‑word alignment. - **যা** (the first occurrence in line 17) – added in Bengali to introduce the participial clause, but the Italian line 17 has no explicit relative pronoun; therefore it is unnecessary for a literal alignment.
All other source tokens are correctly rendered in the Bengali translation with appropriate meaning and grammatical function.

### Step 4: Correction & Final Output Fix any MISSING, WRONG, or GRAMMAR items from Step 3. Reorder within line if needed; do not add new content words. Verify that the output contains only Bengali script; no other language scripts should be mixed in. Output format (use nested bullet list, not table): - Line N: - Original: ... - Issue: ... (or "none") - Corrected: ... (or "no change") Output final Bengali text in ONE code block, line by line (no extra prose).

- **Line 16** - Original: আমি উপরে তাকালাম এবং তার কাঁধ দেখলাম - Issue: Unnecessary subject pronoun “আমি”. - Corrected: উচ্চে তাকালাম এবং তার কাঁধ দেখলাম
- **Line 17** - Original: যা ইতিমধ্যে গ্রহের রশ্মি দ্বারা আবৃত - Issue: Unnecessary relative pronoun “যা”. - Corrected: গ্রহের রশ্মি দ্বারা ইতিমধ্যে আবৃত
- **Line 18** - Original: যা মানুষকে প্রতিটি পথে সরলভাবে পরিচালনা করে। - Issue: Unnecessary relative pronoun “যা”. - Corrected: গ্রহ মানুষকে প্রতিটি পথে সরলভাবে পরিচালনা করে।
```text উচ্চে তাকালাম এবং তার কাঁধ দেখলাম গ্রহের রশ্মি দ্বারা ইতিমধ্যে আবৃত গ্রহ মানুষকে প্রতিটি পথে সরলভাবে পরিচালনা করে। ```
